Les pétales de Rose-de-Renard sont consommés pour restaurer 2 à 12 points de vie. Le guérisseur emploie directement la partie florale, sans préparation liquide particulière. La plante reste difficile à trouver sur les berges du monde occidental où elle est signalée.

This petal is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Foxrose petals are swallowed to restore 2–12 concussion hits. The flower parts are used directly, without any special liquid preparation. The plant is difficult to find on the riverbanks of the western lands where it is recorded.
